properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 10 at 11:28AM EDT until August 10 at 12:30PM EDT by NWS Pittsburgh PA
properties.description:

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 10 at 10:39AM EDT until August 10 at 11:45AM EDT by NWS Buffalo NY
properties.description:
SMWBUF

The National Weather Service in Buffalo has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Lake Erie from Ripley to Sturgeon Point...

* Until 1145 AM EDT.

* At 1039 AM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located near Ripley, or

properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 10 at 11:32AM EDT until August 10 at 2:30PM EDT by NWS Pittsburgh PA
properties.description:
FFWPBZ

The National Weather Service in Pittsburgh has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northern Harrison County in east central Ohio...
Southern Jefferson OH County in east central Ohio...

* Until 230 PM EDT.

* At 1132 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.5 and 1.5 inches of
rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5 inches
are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Steubenville, Cadiz, Wellsburg, Wintersville, Mingo Junction,
Hopedale, Smithfield, Scio, Adena, Jewett, Dillonvale, Beech
Bottom, Brilliant, Bowerston, New Alexandria, Bloomingdale,
Unionport, Newell and Brentwood.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 10 at 11:31AM EDT until August 10 at 12:00PM EDT by NWS Pittsburgh PA
properties.description:
At 1131 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from
near Wellsburg to 8 miles north of Woodsfield, moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Wheeling, Steubenville, Moundsville, Martins Ferry, St.
Clairsville, Bellaire, Cadiz, Warwood, Wellsburg, Bethlehem, West
Liberty, Triadelphia, Avella, Clearview, Valley Grove,
Wintersville, Shadyside, Mingo Junction and Follansbee.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. These storms are capable of producing damaging winds.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Lightning is one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can
hear thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with these storms and may lead
to flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.
